trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Dense input tensor with arbitrary shape; index tensor contains one or more elements used to index a target dimension.
trigger_condition.dtype_trigger: Index tensor dtype int64; input tensor is a normal dense floating-point tensor.
trigger_condition.device_trigger: CPU, CUDA, or MPS device paths may expose the compiled-mode inconsistency.
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Index tensor contains negative values, such as [-1], [-2], or values near -dimension_size.
trigger_condition.state_trigger: Execution mode differs between eager and torch.compile backend='inductor'.
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Run torch.index_select under eager mode and under torch.compile(backend='inductor') and compare behavior.
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: torch.index_select(x, dim, indices) with indices containing negative values; eager mode should raise, while Inductor compiled mode may incorrectly succeed.

root_cause.api_layer: torch.index_select defines strict non-negative index semantics and should reject negative indices.
root_cause.backend_layer: Inductor decomposition lowers index_select into an indexing operation that supports negative index wrapping, violating eager API semantics.

bug_oracle.description: Behavior mismatch where eager mode raises an exception for negative indices but Inductor compiled mode executes successfully.
bug_oracle.signal: RuntimeError in eager mode; no error in Inductor compiled mode

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Replace valid indices with negative values; include boundary values near -dimension_size and mixed positive/negative index tensors.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Create dense input tensors with random shapes and int64 index tensors containing negative values.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force execution under both eager mode and torch.compile(backend='inductor') for the same input.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Execute torch.index_select in eager mode and compiled Inductor mode on identical input tensors and indices.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Flag any case where eager mode raises an exception but compiled mode succeeds, or where both execute but return inconsistent results.
